tool.name: ART Illumina
tool.command: #if $input_type == "fasta": ln -s '$input_fasta' input.fa && #else: ln -s '$input_fasta' input.fa.gz && #end if art_illumina -i input.fa -l $read_length -o output -p $pairing -m $insert_size -s $insert_size_std -f $coverage -q $quality -a $adapter -n $adapter_length -r $adapter_mismatch -t \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1} -x $seed -e $error_rate -u $unpaired -c $circular -C $circular -M $mismatches -R $read_group -T $tag -G $gap -g $gap_std -S $seed -N $n_base -Q $q_base -B $base -D $dimer -E $error -F $flowcell -H $hetero -K $kmer -L $length -O $offset -P $polymerase -W $window -Y $yield -Z $zlib -h

param.name: input_type
param.label: Input type
param.help: Select the type of input file you have

param.name: input_fasta
param.label: Input file
param.help: Select the input file to use for the simulation

param.name: read_length
param.label: Read length
param.help: The length of the reads to generate

param.name: pairing
param.label: Pairing
param.help: Select the type of reads to generate

param.name: insert_size
param.label: Insert size
param.help: The insert size for paired-end or mate-pair reads

param.name: insert_size_std
param.label: Insert size standard deviation
param.help: The standard deviation of the insert size for paired-end or mate-pair reads

param.name: adapter_length
param.label: Adapter length
param.help: The length of the adapter sequence to use

param.name: adapter_mismatch
param.label: Adapter mismatch
param.help: The number of mismatches allowed in the adapter sequence

param.name: seed
param.label: Seed
param.help: The seed for the random number generator

param.name: error_rate
param.label: Error rate
param.help: The error rate for the reads

param.name: mismatches
param.label: Mismatches
param.help: The number of mismatches to allow

param.name: gap_std
param.label: Gap standard deviation
param.help: The standard deviation of the gap to use

param.name: n_base
param.label: N base
param.help: The number of N bases to use

tool.help:
Art Illumina Simulator ======================
ART (art_Illumina Q version) is a simulation program to generate sequence read data of Illumina sequencers. ART generates reads according to the empirical read quality profile summarized from large real read data. ART has been using for testing or benchmarking a variety of methods or tools for next-generation sequencing data analysis, including read alignment, de novo assembly, detection of SNP, CNV, or other structure variation.
art_Illumina can generate single-end, paired-end, mate-pair reads, and amplicon sequencing simulation of Illumina sequencing platform. Its outputs include FASTQ read, ALN and/or SAM alignment files.
